'''2000 Minneapolis Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Best Western Drover's Inn, 701 South Concord St., South St. Paul, Minnesota
* '''Tournament director:''' Chris Perman
* '''Players:''' 48<ref name="tr-d1383" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub names Chris Perman as tournament director, but this report thanks Dion Erbes for running the tournament, and Perman played in it (Joshua Grace and Rich Jeffery each played him).<ref name="tr-d1383" />
